newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SCA to cooperate with India's Rank Group.
newsitem.headline: SCA to cooperate with India's Rank Group.

text.p: Swedish forestry group SCA said on Thursday its packaging unit has established cooperation with Indian fish farming company Rank Group of Hyderabad.
"The intent is to gradually build up packaging operations in India, with a packaging unit in Bangalore as the first step," an SCA statement said.
Rank group will make the investment with technical support from SCA Packaging, which has an option to acquire a 50 percent stake in the new packaging company.

SCA also signed a cooperation agreement with Indonesian paper manufacturer Fayar Surya Wisesa (FSW) "in order to secure a favourable raw material supply for the current ventures in Asia," the company said.
SCA has previously said it intends to establish two complete corrugated board plants in China, each with a capacity of 40-50 million square meters.

"Long term contracts have been signed for both plants covering deliveries of corrugated board to international customers in China," the company said, adding that it would invest about 285 million crowns in the plants.

About 130 million crowns of the investment is assigned to SCA's and Weyerhaeuser's joint packaging company in Asia, Weyerhaeuser Packaging Holding Company Ltd., and the balance of the finance would be arranged locally, the company said.

"The cooperation with Weyerhaeuser has now been expanded to include a joint sales organisation for liner products in Asia, with offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore and India," the company said.
